caption: The drawing features a sleeveless, light gray or off-white vest with a subtle sheen, suggesting a silky or satin-like fabric. The vest has a high collar that folds outward and a deep V-shaped neckline. It is fastened in the front with a row of five round, cloth-covered buttons. The fabric of the vest is patterned with a repeating leaf and vine design in shades of gray, with accents of gold detailing throughout, giving the appearance of an embroidered or brocade texture. There are two horizontal slit pockets, one on each side near the lower edge of the vest. The inner lining of the garment is visible around the neckline and armholes and appears to be a plain, light beige or tan color. The background of the drawing is a plain, neutral off-white, with no other objects or embellishments present.
title: Vest
